sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Charisma is a Mental skill in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Mastering the art of charisma allows to receive discounts on various services.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - The progress for this skill is shared between your PMC and Scav character.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
- Reduces operational task replacement cost (0.1% per level → -5% at Elite Level)
- Reduces after-raid healing services prices (0.1% per level → -5% at Elite Level)
- Reduces insurance services prices (0.1% per level → -5% at Elite Level)
- Reduces paid exfil prices (0.1% per level → -5% at Elite Level)
- Elite level: Adds a discount to Scav Case prices (10% Reduction)
- Elite level: Reduces Fence standing penalty (50% Reduction, does apply at 6+ Scav karma)
- Elite level: Adds one more daily operational task

sections.heading: How to raise
sections.text:
- 10% of points of EXP gained for Intellect will be added to Charisma skill progression
- 20% of points of EXP gained for Attention or Perception will be added to Charisma skill progression
- Using the Scav Case
  - Grants 0.4 points every time you send Scavs to search for loot
- Insuring your gear
  - Grants 0.4 points for every 200,000 Roubles spent
- Repairing Weapons or Body armor with Traders
  - Grants 0.4 points for every 10,000 Roubles spent
- Completing the quest Special Order
- Completing the quest A Life Lesson
- Completing the quest Antique Enthusiast
- Completing the quest Regulated Materials
- Completing the quest Never Too Late To Learn

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: - The skill icon is inspired by a picture of Tom Hardy.
